sql:
WITH SegmentAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) as AnnualAvg
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
SegmentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        COUNT(*) as Count
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
LeastConsumptionAS AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customerid,
        c.segment,
        SUM(c.consumption) as TotalConsumption,
        MIN(c.consumption) as MinConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN segment_count sc ON c.customerid = sc.customerid
    WHERE c.segment = sc.segment
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
AnnualDiff AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customerid,
        s.segment,
        CAST(s.annualavg AS REAL) * 12 AS TotalAnnually,
        s.min_consumption,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.annualavg < MIN(s.min_consumption) THEN -1
            ELSE 1
        END AS Significance
    FROM SegmentAvg s
    LEFT JOIN LeastConsumptionAS lcs ON s.customerid = lcs.customerid AND s.segment = lcs.segment
),
FinalResult AS (
    SELECT 
        customerid,
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN significance = 1 THEN AnnualDiff ELSE 0 END) as AnnualDifference,
        SUM(CASE WHEN significance = -1 THEN AnnualDiff ELSE 0 END) as NegativeDiff
    FROM AnnualDiff
    GROUP BY customerid, segment
),
YearMonth AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', Date) AS Year,
        Date
    FROM "yearmonth"
)
SELECT 
    YEAR(MYear) || '-' || MONTH(MDate) AS QueryDate,
    ROUND(SUM(Diff), 2) AS AvgConsumptionDiff
FROM FinalResult
GROUP BY Diff

        dr.surname,
        MIN(q2.position) as q2_pos,

        q2.number,

    WHERE q.status = 'q2'

        SUM(h.weight_kg) as total_weight
